mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months where PAYEMS exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening supply-side capacity utilization, which signals economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO below-ma periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) combined with a decline in unemployment rate signals strong consumer confidence and labor market tightness, which drives positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS rises and UNRATE falls (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals inflation expectations are becoming entrenched, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 8.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, combined with a flat or declining housing market (HOUST), signals a weakening demand environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 < 1.0% and HOUST < 700k (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
